description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for firmware images, including a check function that always succeeds and an upgrade function that delegates to device-specific upgrade procedures based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that performs a check on the firmware image; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: A function that performs the upgrade process for the platform, delegating to specific upgrade functions based on the detected board name.
